title: Payment decision under sanctions escalation signal
scenario_pattern: A critical supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction has near-term invoices due while sanctions risk is escalating and contract continuity matters.
outcome: Escalated to CFO, Legal, Procurement, and Accounting; payment was held until sanctions screening and alternate supply options were reviewed.

title: Supplier bank country creates payment reroute uncertainty
scenario_pattern: Supplier operations are outside the sanctioned jurisdiction, but the nominated bank or correspondent bank is exposed to the event country.
outcome: Treasury capped confidence at medium until bank route confirmation and legal review were complete.
